description: Load-following FBR (sodium-cooled) with Xe-135 dynamics and sodium void reactivity feedback. FBR uses fast neutrons: Xe absorption cross-section is ~3 orders of magnitude smaller than thermal, making xenon poisoning negligible.

unit.name: Generic 1000 MWe Sodium-Cooled Fast Breeder Reactor (BN-800/ASTRID-class)
unit.source: Guidez & Prele (2017) Sodium Cooled Fast Reactors, EDP Sciences; Koch (2008) FAST BREEDER REACTORS: An Engineering Introduction, Elsevier; IAEA (2012) Status of Fast Reactor Technology, IAEA-TECDOC-1689.

P_thermal_mw.note: Thermal power at full load (BN-800 class: 2100 MWth nominal)

eta_thermal.note: Net efficiency; sodium fast reactor drives high-pressure steam cycle at ~500C -> ~39%

sigma_Xe_cm2.note: Xe-135 fast-spectrum cross-section is ~3 orders of magnitude lower than thermal (2.65e-18 cm2 thermal vs ~2.65e-22 cm2 fast); xenon poisoning negligible in FBR

ramp_rate_limit_pct_min.note: Sodium-cooled FBR ramp rate limited by thermal gradients in large sodium pool and breeding blanket structural integrity; 3%/min typical (BN-800 operational experience)

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable power; sodium natural circulation provides passive safety below ~25% power

total_reactivity_margin_pcm.note: FBR uses control/safety rods with boron carbide; margin sufficient for shutdown and transient control

xenon_reactivity_coeff_pcm.note: Xe reactivity worth in fast spectrum is negligible (<50 pcm) vs thermal reactor (-3000 pcm); xenon deadtime does not limit FBR load-following

sodium_void_coeff_pcm_per_pct.note: Sodium void reactivity coefficient [pcm per 1% void]; POSITIVE in large FBR cores (safety concern mitigated by design margins, negative Doppler); typical +5 to +20 pcm/%void

doppler_coeff_pcm_per_K.note: Doppler temperature coefficient; negative in U238 bearing fast fuel, partially offsets positive void coefficient

T_sodium_rated_C.note: Average core outlet sodium temperature at rated power (BN-800: ~510C outlet)
